reference.citation: Kruskal WH, Wallis WA (1952) one-way analysis of variance by ranks. Reference impls: scipy.stats.kruskal and base R stats::kruskal.test. Data: vertical-GRF push-off peak (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) in healthy controls vs four lower-limb pathology classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes the tie-corrected Kruskal-Wallis H of the vertical-GRF push-off peak across the five gait classes with scipy.stats.kruskal and base R kruskal.test and confirms kruskalTest reproduces base R bit-for-bit and scipy to machine precision; also reports the per-class mean ranks (healthy-highest, calcaneus-lowest) and the design sizes
